source.content: public class BatchLifecycleProbeBatch implements Database.Batchable<SObject> { public Database.QueryLocator start(Database.BatchableContext bc) { System.assertNotEquals(null, bc); System.assertNotEquals('', bc.getJobId()); System.assertEquals(null, bc.getChildJobId()); return Database.getQueryLocator('SELECT Id FROM Account LIMIT 1'); } public void execute(Database.BatchableContext bc, List<SObject> scope) { System.assertNotEquals('', bc.getJobId()); } public void finish(Database.BatchableContext bc) { System.assertNotEquals('', bc.getJobId()); } }

@isTest private class AsyncBatchableLifecycleFixtureTest { @isTest static void executesBatchLifecycleWithScope() { Test.startTest(); String jobId = Database.executeBatch(new BatchLifecycleProbeBatch(), 1); Test.stopTest(); System.assertNotEquals('', jobId); } @isTest static void executesBatchLifecycleWithDefaultScope() { Test.startTest(); String jobId = Database.executeBatch(new BatchLifecycleProbeBatch()); Test.stopTest(); System.assertNotEquals('', jobId); } }
